# URL

Encode, decode and break down URLs (percent-encoding).

Category: Encoders · ID: `url` · Search terms: percent, encode, decode, query, parse, uri

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui url [encode|decode|parse] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode`, `parse` | `encode` | Mode. |
| `--escape` | `query`, `path` | `query` | Escape. query: space → '+'; path: space → '%20' |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/url`), so they are what the tool prints.

### decode-query

```text
Hello world & café: a=b/c?d#e
```

### encode-path

```text
Hello%20world%20&%20caf%C3%A9:%20a=b%2Fc%3Fd%23e
```

### encode-query

```text
Hello+world+%26+caf%C3%A9%3A+a%3Db%2Fc%3Fd%23e
```

### parse-full

User:       ana
Password:   s3cr3t
